svg.title: Pundoku — знак D5 «Унос» — favicon / малый знак
svg.desc:
The D5 mark with no ground plate, drawn on a 16-unit grid: every edge lands on an integer, so at 16, 32, 48 and 64 px the straight edges rasterize with no antialiasing and the corridor is exactly 2, 4, 6 and 8 whole background pixels. Field 12 with a 4 bite and radius 2; carried cell 4 with radius 1; corridor 2 on both axes; content 14 of 16 (87.5 percent of the canvas) rather than the 56 percent the plated icon uses, because a favicon has no plate to sit inside.
One colour, #5F6DF2 — the dark stop of the carried cell's ink gradient. It is deliberately NOT wrapped in a prefers-color-scheme switch: Safari ignores prefers-color-scheme inside an SVG favicon and renders the base version anyway, so the base has to be safe on a light and a dark tab regardless; #5F6DF2 is 4.24:1 on #FFFFFF and 4.02:1 on #1C1C1E. Adding the media query would only make Chrome and Firefox disagree with Safari, for no legibility gain.
The same two paths, with fill="currentColor", are what Mark.tsx should draw at 60 px and below (see pd98-logo-round3.md, "Решение владельца и реализация D5").
